meta.name: Nium API Health Monitor — synthetic demo dataset
meta.disclaimer: Demo data / synthetic telemetry. Not real Nium traffic, customer data, or measured Nium performance. Customer names (Acme, Airbnb, Initech) are illustrative placeholders.

retention.metrics: Every request is counted in 5-minute aggregates with latency histograms.
retention.requests: All failed and slow (≥1000 ms) requests, payouts that later failed or had webhook problems, and a 1% sample of other successful requests.
retention.webhooks: All failed and delayed deliveries plus a 1% sample of delivered ones, for retained requests.

sandboxRateLimits.source: Nium usage limits page (sandbox only; production limits not published)

documentedFacts.requestIdHeader: x-request-id (36-character UUID, sent on every request)
